title: Acute appendicitis

patient.name: Rohan
patient.chief_complaint: Stomach pain since yesterday that has moved to the lower right side.
patient.history: Pain began around the belly button, moved to the right lower abdomen over 12 hours. Nausea, no appetite, one episode of vomiting. Low-grade fever. Pain worse when walking or coughing. No previous surgery. No medications. No allergies.

abd_rlq.say: Ow! That is exactly where it hurts.
abd_rlq.deep_say: Aaah, please stop, that really hurts!
abd_rlq.rebound_say: Aaaah! It hurts even more when you let go!

abd_llq.say: Hmm, that makes the right side hurt.

chest_apex.description: Normal S1 and S2, no murmurs.

teaching_points: Classic migration of pain from periumbilical region to RLQ.
Assess McBurney's point tenderness, rebound tenderness and guarding.
Consider Rovsing's, psoas and obturator signs.
